caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular stage or display frame with ornate golden columns along the sides and top and bottom edges, featuring a detailed, circular design in each corner. The central upper section of the frame contains a scene with a woman dressed in a light blue bonnet and a white dress with red accents, sitting on a chair, reading or holding an object, on a grassy green floor. This scene is set against a light background with a red curtain, gathered at the top and partially open to reveal the woman. Below this scene, the bulk of the rectangular frame is filled with a light grayish or off-white panel. To the right of the main drawing, there is a simple black line side view of the frame's profile. To the left, below the frame, is a small, annotated drawing illustrating the detailed decorative pattern of the column ends. The drawing is rendered in ink, watercolor, and possibly pencil, with color accents mainly in gold, red, blue, and green. The artist's signature and the scale notation are present at the bottom.
title: Mirror
